capabilities: Search and replace text in the current file from a floating editor bar
Preview replacements as a live inline diff before applying
Match text with JavaScript regex, case sensitivity, and whole-word toggles
Replace the current match or all matches with navigation and counters
Customize highlight and preview colors and default search options
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Works on both desktop and mobile.
intentEvidence: assign any shortcut (e.g. Cmd/Ctrl+F) to replace the built-in search
problem: Obsidian's built-in find and replace lacks live diff preview, regex capture groups, and inline match navigation in the editor.

relations.evidence: accessible from the helpers modal when the note-toolbar plugin is installed

summary: Search and replace plugin with a floating editor bar, live match highlighting, diff preview, and JavaScript regex with capture groups.
